identity.title: Lock a real governance regression comparison as a golden case

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: After 8067 proves one real baseline/current comparison, preserve that evidence-backed comparison as a compact golden regression case. Do not invent a prettier transition matrix. The expected IMPROVED/REGRESSED/UNCHANGED/UNKNOWN/INCOMPARABLE results must come from the human-reviewed real comparison produced by 8067.
human_pressure.why_now: The governance regression feature only becomes durable when at least one real comparison is reproducible and protected from silent semantic drift.
red_lines: No producer identity in comparison semantics.

machine_core.goal: Add a deterministic production-derived golden comparison for compare_governance_projections using only facts and expected transitions accepted in 8067.
invariants: Expected transitions are frozen before test implementation from 8067 evidence.
The two projections remain independently valid and inspectable.

steps.title: Extract accepted comparison
details: Use the exact comparable baseline/current pair reviewed in 8067.
Record only normalized canonical governance facts needed for the comparison.

steps.title: Freeze expected transitions
details: Encode the human-reviewed expected transition for each existing regression dimension.
Preserve UNKNOWN/INCOMPARABLE where evidence requires them.

steps.title: Prove determinism
details: Run comparison repeatedly and require stable ordered output.

acceptance: At least one real evidence-backed comparison is represented as a golden regression case.
No expected transition is invented after observing failing tests.
No regression dimension or rank policy changes.

producer.artifact: deterministic golden comparison case for compare_governance_projections

observable_effect.assertion: At least one real evidence-backed comparison is represented as a golden regression case with correct expected transitions.

proofs.assertion: Golden regression test passes with accepted transition expectations.

must_check: 8067 completed with a genuinely comparable real pair.
Golden expectations match the recorded human-reviewed 8067 result.
No comparison ranking or dimension is changed in this pack.
reject_if: A synthetic pair replaces the 8067 real comparison without disclosure.
Expected outputs are rewritten merely to make tests pass.
